$comment: Assignment rules for the ticket routing engine. Edit and restart to apply. skillLevel scale: 1=junior (L1), 2=standard (L2), 3=senior (L3). Which group a ticket goes to, and the minimum skill it needs, come from the RoutingRule rows (Routing -> Routing Rules) — the 'categories' map that used to live here was removed because it was a second, silently-drifting copy of the same rule.
